## What changed

Describe the user or maintainer problem and the smallest change that solves it.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run test`
- [ ] `npm run build`

## Content and security

- [ ] No new runtime dependency, or the dependency was approved in an issue.
- [ ] New assets have a license, source, checksum, and provenance note.
- [ ] Public API or environment-variable changes are documented.
- [ ] Fork CI does not require repository secrets.
